answer: Mechanism: receipt-vine divergence audit. Agents keep signed append-only interaction receipts. A dune-seeded challenge periodically requires a short random wander over that vine, revealing selected receipt hashes and counterparty co-signatures. Cloned sybils either reuse receipts—identical wander transcripts expose linkage—or must build disjoint histories with real co-signers. Cost: each identity needs independent co-signed interactions plus challenge-response storage/compute; cloning leaks via transcript collisions.
